shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md && printf '\\n--- skill files ---\\n' && rg --files . | rg '("'^|/)SKILL'"\\.md"'$|tdd-loop|parallel-change'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git log -3 --oneline && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && cat package.json && cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface ToolDefinition|type ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts | head -80 && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts && rg -n \"export interface Options|strict\" node_modules/ajv/dist/core.d.ts node_modules/ajv/dist/types/index.d.ts | head -80"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\" && cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | sed -n '1,45p' && rg -n \"interface Options\" node_modules/ajv | head -20"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/.+#|@spec|spec:" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80; ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true; git status --short'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git diff --check && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): cache dynamic input schemas" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
